text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how formidable the opponent, 
Mejiro Ramonu displays overwhelming 
strength. The entire venue shakes with 
shock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stimulated by the high-level race, a 
thrilled Mejiro Ramonu longs to reach even 
greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. in the stands was also 
inspired... and challenged her to a 
showdown at the Japan Cup. Mejiro Ramonu 
gladly accepted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd buzzed with excitement over her 
showdown with the Triple Crown Umamusume. 
Symboli Rudolf watched the turf from the 
VIP seats with a complex gaze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, where 
fillies from the Tiara route compete for 
elegance and prestige. Claim the queen's 
throne and elevate her renown even 
higher――!
